FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Everything You Need to Know

What is AI motion transfer and how does Genjutsu AI work? +

AI motion transfer extracts the skeletal movement, gestures, and performance from a source reference video and applies it to a still character photo. Genjutsu AI calculates 3D pose, hands, and facial geometry in every frame, synthesizing a fluid, continuous video where the character performs the choreography with their face, clothing, and art style 100% intact.

How is Genjutsu AI different from generic face swap apps? +

Traditional face swap only replaces the face within an existing video, leaving the original body, clothes, and physique untouched. Genjutsu AI performs full-character animation: it generates a completely new video of your chosen character from head to toe, matching their authentic silhouette, clothing folds, and hair motion to the choreography.

Does it work with anime, 3D avatars, and illustrated art? +

Yes! Genjutsu AI is style-preserving. Photoreal portraits stay photoreal, 3D digital sculptures keep their metallic reflections and geometry, and anime illustrations maintain clean cel-shading and 2D outlines without looking like an unnatural photo filter.

What kind of photos work best? +

A clear, well-lit photo showing the character from head to waist (or full body) with neutral pose. Both real human portraits and digital art work seamlessly.

Can I upload my own custom dance or workout video? +

Yes. In addition to our built-in viral motion library, you can upload any MP4 or MOV video between 5 and 30 seconds to serve as the custom choreography reference.

What output format and resolution do I receive? +

All completed renders are delivered as native vertical 9:16 MP4 files at 1080x1920 HD resolution, complete with audio matching the dance routine, ready for instant posting on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

What happens if a video render fails? +

Our Credit Protection Guarantee automatically refunds your spent credit back to your account ledger immediately if a rendering job fails. You never pay for an uncompleted generation.

Do you own the rights to the videos you generate? +

Yes. You retain full ownership and commercial rights to post, monetize, and distribute the videos you create from photos you own or have permission to use.
